definition.terminal: from frozen batch_samples: final recorded decision row true, all earlier rows false
definition.bootstrap: recorded task/cost value at next tape row for every earlier row; final row zero
definition.active_row: tape.actionable has at least one target
definition.update_source_identity: fixed-point eligibility requires checkpoint file SHA256, checkpoint parameter/lambda identity vs current batch record, saved likelihood count vs tape, and UPDATE_MECHANISM sample counts to agree. The six b0 points agree; b15/b31 points fail identity/count gates and are stopped.

synthetic_gae_validation.engine: source-bound JavaScript translation of frozen cost_math.gae; native Python/PyTorch unavailable

direct_reward_transfer.formula: For a task reward in tape row j, its direct contribution to A_task at earlier row i with no terminal boundary between is (gamma*lambda_GAE)^(j-i); full-mask rows remain in j-i.
direct_reward_transfer.interpretation: Coefficient measures only the explicit reward path with critic predictions fixed; a small value does not mean the training signal has no long-term information because critic value/bootstrap terms may compensate.
